At a coffee shop, a Catholic person and a Mormon man are discussing their dating lives. The Catholic person discussed their upcoming nuptials with their long-time partner and the Mormon man discussed how to remodel his house to accommodate separate bedrooms for each of his wives. Who had a single partner?
A. The Catholic man
B. The Mormon man
C. Unknown
